messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: For the pop up that let's you know acquired or sent stuff have an option to undo it as to avoid what I did by accidentally buying cities instead of land.

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@307290318590705667> no undo button, since a refund would let people use it to swap/dupe stuff for free. But I fixed the real cause: both buttons just said Purchase. They're now Buy Cities and Buy Land, and each asks you to confirm the exact amount and type before it goes through. Live now.
